title: Karpov Hunts the Bishop
setup: Karpov against Korchnoi, Moscow 1974. Your pawns have come up the kingside, and one black piece still guards the dark squares around Black's king.
hint: Against a fianchetto you are hunting one piece. Which of yours walks the same squares as it?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Bh6}} offers your dark-squared bishop for Black's, the one piece that answers for f6 and h6. After {{Bxh6}} {{Qxh6}} the queen lands on the square the g-pawn gave up and stares at g7 and h7, and no black pawn can ever chase it away.

Karpov kept coming with the g-pawn and the rooks, and Black resigned ten moves later.
